3. Extracted AllowanceChargeType's full xsd:sequence directly from the pinned OASIS UBL 2.3 CommonAggregateComponents schema (.local/format-contracts/acquired/ubl/src-ubl-002.bin) rather than guessing: confirmed ChargeIndicator (maxOccurs=1, required), AllowanceChargeReasonCode (maxOccurs=1, optional), and Amount (maxOccurs=1, optional) match this package's modeled fields, in that declared order; AllowanceChargeReason is maxOccurs=UNBOUNDED (genuinely repeatable) despite this package's own AllowanceCharge.reason field modeling only the first occurrence -- deliberately excluded from both checks, matching the same model-scoping exclusion already documented for PaymentMeans.PaymentID and Response.Description.

4. Added _ALLOWANCE_CHARGE_QNAME and _ALLOWANCE_CHARGE_SINGLE_OCCURRENCE_FIELDS to validator.py, and one entry each to _CARDINALITY_CHECKED_COMPONENTS and _ORDER_CHECKED_COMPONENTS, reusing the identical qname-keyed dispatch pattern already proven for every prior component in this cluster -- zero changes to the dispatch functions themselves.

5. Probed directly before writing formal tests: a document with a duplicate ChargeIndicator was refused by dumps() naming the exact cardinality violation; a document with Amount before ChargeIndicator was refused naming the exact order violation; a well-formed document (correct cardinality and order) serialized without incident. All 3 correct on the first attempt.

7. 8. Ran ruff (clean), the full ubl suite (949 passed, was 941, +8), and the full 6-format regression (3401 passed, was 3393, +8; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.
